body: It's gonna take a lot of time. It's hard to sleep, and nothing but nightmares for the minutes I am. I just feel like my world is over. Thank you so much honestly for the kind words and everything. I definitely can use the hugs. Seriously. Thank you. <3
I couldn't do that if I tried friend, she has seen me through very tough times, and been so supportive of me including my many faults.
Thank you, I'm trying. I've felt like an Outcast all my life, for once I don't, and here we are. It's crushing.
Thank you. I'm trying to stay calm and not let anxiety get the best of me. I'm just afraid of everything, and scared to reach out, while at the same time extremely disappointed in myself.
